+    def _add_fast_delete(self, qs):
+        """
+        Add a queryset to the fast deletes, combining it with an existing one
+        for the same model when the resulting query doesn't exceed the
+        database's parameter limit.
+        """
+        max_query_params = connections[self.using].features.max_query_params
+        for i, combined_qs in enumerate(self.fast_deletes):
+            if combined_qs.model is not qs.model:
+                continue
+            new_qs = combined_qs | qs
+            if max_query_params is not None:
+                _, params = new_qs.query.get_compiler(self.using).as_sql()
+                if len(params) > max_query_params:
+                    continue
+            self.fast_deletes[i] = new_qs
+            return
+        self.fast_deletes.append(qs)
+
     def collect(self, objs, source=None, nullable=False, collect_related=True,
